headerSiteLinkedDescription: . Site selection syncs Dashboard, OnePage, Emails, Calendar, and Word Cloud; Cross-Market Comparison is selected independently.
footerTotalMeaningText1: All email counts tracked on this dashboard represent publicly visible email samples archived by Milled within the statistical window, reflecting competitors' public marketing cadence, scheduling frequency, and thematic rhythm;
footerTotalMeaningHighlight: not the total delivery volume sent by brands to their full private audience (Delivery Volume).
footerCutoffTimeTitle: Fixed Cutoff Date and Time Standard
footerJsonIntro: This study uses a historical snapshot with a cutoff date of
footerJsonWindowPart2: days of historical window. The snapshot window is fixed and does not roll with daily tasks or calendar days.
footerLiveIntro: This study sets a fixed cutoff date of
footerLiveWindowPart2: days of rolling window. The cutoff date advances after successful daily update tasks, maintaining
footerLiveWindowPart3: days to ensure horizontal comparability and reproducibility across brands and sites; the window does not advance with calendar days.
footerTimeStandardText1: All send dates are archived and aligned to
footerMarketCoverageText: The system is configured with 8 markets (US, UK, AU, FR, DE, IT, NL, ES). Currently 7 markets have archived records; Spain (ES) has 0 records (no emails after selection). Italy (IT) and Netherlands (NL) have archived records.
footerMarketJsonNote: (Currently offline snapshot, displaying historical US 770 sample emails only.)
footerBrandRulesText: Monitoring covers 6 brands: Zara, lululemon, ALO Yoga, Halara, Temu, and SHEIN. Topic classification is determined by subject line and content highlights, with each email uniquely assigned to one dominant topic; keyword frequency is calculated by unique email count containing the word; the dashboard strictly adheres to compliance boundaries and does not quote unauthorized original copy from competitors.
